# Knovas Assistent

> The one company assistant of the Platform's Workspace, which answers a signed-in person's question only from the passages that person's own search returns, shows only statements whose references it could check, and keeps that person's past chats.

## Purpose

### Responsible for

| Id | Aliases | Statement | Code |
|---|---|---|---|
| `L2-PLATFORM-ASSISTANT/R-1` | `RESP-01` | Answers a signed-in person's question from passages the Brain returned to that person, with a checked reference per statement. | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/assistant` |
| `L2-PLATFORM-ASSISTANT/R-2` |  | Past chats (W-07): what a person asked and the answers as they were shown, with their references, stored in the Platform's own database in new tables only, listed, opened and deleted by their owner only (plan § 5.2). | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/identity/chats.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/identity/migrations/0026_assistant_chats.sql` |
| `L2-PLATFORM-ASSISTANT/R-3` |  | The ask page (W-01, W-03, PMVP-22a): POST /fragen takes the question from the search page's box, asks the service once for the signed-in person and shows the reply: each statement with its reference, which opens the statement's quote right under it; the passages; no answer with the closest passages; busy or failed as the plain message. The switch Fragen / Suchen beside the box (ask.js) sends a question there and leaves searching to the search page. | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/assistant_routes.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/templates/ask.html`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/static/css/ask.css`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/static/js/ask.js` |

### Not responsible for

- Reading documents any other way than through the person's own search; there is no second way (plan § 5.2, step 2).
- Deciding who may see a document; the Brain's search does, as the signed-in person.
- The search page and the document view; they belong to the Platform's web app (index.html draws the box and the switch only when the ask page says the assistant is on).
- Opening a document from a reference; the web app's file routes serve what retrieval handed the person.

### Terms

- reference (a number in an answer that points to a passage retrieved for this person in this chat)
- passage (a hit's verbatim text that the person's search returned, numbered in search order)
- chat (one person's questions and the answers as they were shown, with their references)

## Uses

| Component | Operations | Expects | Method | Protocol |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `EXT-BRAIN-API` |  |  | POST /secured/query (the person's own search, the only way the assistant reads documents) and POST /secured/llm/generate (one whole answer, no streaming), through the Platform's client (knovas_client.py) on the Platform's certificate, as the signed-in person (plan § 5.2) | HTTPS with mTLS |
| `EXT-ANTHROPIC-API` | `messages` | `EXT-ANTHROPIC-API/messages/P-1`; `EXT-ANTHROPIC-API/messages/P-2` | when the customer chose anthropic (assistant.provider): the official SDK (anthropic==2.12.0), client.beta.messages.create, on the key and the model of the settings registry, with the system instruction and the composed messages only (POST-02); one call per answer, and one per «Verbindung testen» with invented text (src/assistant/providers.py, PMVP-25) | HTTPS |

## Decisions and risks

### Decisions

| Id | Statement |
|---|---|
| `FU-14` | No Alloy model for POST-02 (the founder, 2026-11-19): the assistant gets document content only through the Brain's search, which enforces access. |

### Risks

| Id | Statement | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| `L2-PLATFORM-ASSISTANT/RISK-01` | The check catches a reference number that matches no passage, not one that matches the wrong passage (plan § 7, risks). | The test questions measure it (plan § 11), and the page always shows the passage under the sentence, so the reader sees the evidence itself. |
| `L2-PLATFORM-ASSISTANT/RISK-02` | POST-02 keeps the prompt to what the person's search returns; the search follows the person's rights only where a customer's enforcement is on, and it is off for every tenant today (plan § 3). | No customer is switched to enforcement «Ein» before the Core's end-to-end rights test has passed twice (plan § 8.1, DEC-0082). |
| `L2-PLATFORM-ASSISTANT/RISK-03` | With anthropic chosen (the founder, 2026-11-21: the Platform calls the language model itself and the customer chooses the provider; the pilot chose Anthropic), the passages the person's search returned, the question and its history leave the installation for Anthropic; while enforcement is off (RISK-02) they may hold passages beyond the person's rights. The key is a secret of the installation. | Off and knovas by default; only an administrator chooses anthropic and enters the key; the key is sealed with the deployment's settings key and never shown or logged; PMVP-25 is critical under the repository's CLAUDE.md, so management approves it before main. |
